arxiv-2108-11965.title: A Radiatively Driven Wind from the η \eta Tel Debris Disk Facilities: HST, ALMA astropy ( Robitaille et al. 2013 ) , IPython ( Perez & Granger 2007 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , NumPy and SciPy ( van der Walt et al. 2011 ) , lyapy ( Youngblood et al. 2016 ) , emcee ( Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 )
arxiv-2108-11965.creator: Allison Youngblood, Aki Roberge, Meredith A. MacGregor, Alexis Brandeker, Alycia Weinberger, Sebastián Pérez, Carol Grady, Barry Welsh
arxiv-2108-11965.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Allison Youngblood, Aki Roberge, Meredith A. MacGregor, Alexis Brandeker, Alycia Weinberger, Sebastián Pérez, Carol Grady, Barry Welsh. We present far- and near-ultraviolet absorption spectroscopy of the ∼ \sim 23 Myr edge-on debris disk surrounding the A0V star η \eta Telescopii, obtained with the Hubble Space Telescope Space Telescope Imaging Spectrograph. We detect absorption lines from C I, C II, O I, Mg II, Al II, Si II, S II, Mn II, Fe II, and marginally N I.

arxiv-2109-12020.title: Distributed Estimation of Sparse Inverse Covariances
arxiv-2109-12020.creator: Tong Yao, Shreyas Sundaram
arxiv-2109-12020.description: Abstract Learning the relationships between various entities from time-series data is essential in many applications. Gaussian graphical models have been studied to infer these relationships. However, existing algorithms process data in a batch at a central location, limiting their applications in scenarios where data is gathered by different agents.

arxiv-2204-02315.title: Reverse shock forming condition for magnetized relativistic outflows: reconciling theories and simulations
arxiv-2204-02315.creator: Jing-Ze Ma, Bing Zhang
arxiv-2204-02315.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jing-Ze Ma, Bing Zhang. Reverse shock (RS) emission can be used to probe the properties of the relativistic ejecta, especially the degree of magnetization σ \sigma , in gamma-ray burst (GRB) afterglows. However, there has been confusion in the literature regarding the physical condition for the RS formation, and the role of magnetic fields in the RS dynamics in the Poynting-flux-dominated regime is not fully understood. Exploiting the shock jump conditions, we characterize the properties of a magnetized RS.

arxiv-2306-05353.title: Negotiated Reasoning: On Provably Addressing Relative Over-Generalization
arxiv-2306-05353.creator: Junjie ShengWenhao LiBo Jin, Hongyuan Zha, Jun Wang, Xiangfeng Wang
arxiv-2306-05353.description: Abstract Over-generalization is a thorny issue in cognitive science, where people may become overly cautious due to past experiences. Agents in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) also have been found suffering relative over-generalization (RO) as people do and stuck to sub-optimal cooperation.

arxiv-2401-12195.title: Using spatial extreme-value theory with machine learning to model and understand spatially compounding weather extremes
arxiv-2401-12195.creator: Jonathan Koh 1,2, Daniel Steinfeld 2,3 and Olivia Martius 2
arxiv-2401-12195.description: Abstract When extreme weather events affect large areas, their regional to sub-continental spatial scale is important for their impacts. We propose a novel machine learning (ML) framework that integrates spatial extreme-value theory to model weather extremes and to quantify probabilities associated with the occurrence, intensity, and spatial extent of these events.

arxiv-2409-03823.title: Constraints on the Early Luminosity History of the Sun: Applications to the Faint Young Sun Problem
arxiv-2409-03823.creator: Connor Basinger, Marc Pinsonneault, Sandra T. Bastelberger, B. Scott Gaudi and Shawn D. Domagal-Goldman
arxiv-2409-03823.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Connor Basinger, Marc Pinsonneault, Sandra T. Bastelberger, B. Scott Gaudi and Shawn D. Domagal-Goldman. Stellar evolution theory predicts that the Sun was fainter in the past, which can pose difficulties for understanding Earth’s climate history. One proposed solution to this Faint Young Sun problem is a more luminous Sun in the past. In this paper, we address the robustness of the solar luminosity history using the YREC code to compute solar models including rotation, magnetized winds, and the associated mass loss.

arxiv-2504-17813.title: CLOC: Contrastive Learning for Ordinal Classification with Multi-Margin N-pair Loss
arxiv-2504-17813.creator: Dileepa Pitawela, Gustavo Carneiro, Hsiang-Ting Chen
arxiv-2504-17813.description: Abstract In ordinal classification, misclassifying neighboring ranks is common, yet the consequences of these errors are not the same. For example, misclassifying benign tumor categories is less consequential, compared to an error at the pre-cancerous to cancerous threshold, which could profoundly influence treatment choices.

arxiv-2505-14071.title: Textual Steering Vectors Can Improve Visual Understanding in Multimodal Large Language Models
arxiv-2505-14071.creator: Woody Haosheng Gan Deqing Fu Julian Asilis Ollie Liu Dani Yogatama Vatsal Sharan Robin Jia Willie Neiswanger University of Southern California {woodygan, deqingfu, asilis}@usc.edu, me@ollieliu.com {yogatama, vsharan, robinjia, neiswang}@usc.edu
arxiv-2505-14071.description: Abstract Steering methods have emerged as effective and targeted tools for guiding large language models’ (LLMs) behavior without modifying their parameters. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, do not currently enjoy the same suite of techniques, due in part to their recency and architectural diversity.

arxiv-2506-04187.creator: Gilbert Michaud and Felipe A. Ramírez
arxiv-2506-04187.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gilbert Michaud and Felipe A. Ramírez. Szüsz’s inhomogeneous version (1958) of Khintchine’s theorem (1924) gives conditions on ψ : ℕ → ℝ ⩾ 0 \psi:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{R}_{\geqslant 0} under which for almost every real number α \alpha there exist infinitely many rationals p / q p/q such that | α − p + γ q | < ψ ⁡ ( q ) q , \left\lvert\alpha-\frac{p+\gamma}{q}\right\rvert<\frac{\psi(q)}{q}, where γ ∈ ℝ \gamma\in\mathbb{R} is some fixed inhomogeneous parameter.

pmc-10613515.title: Ceftriaxone-Induced Encephalopathy in a Patient With End-Stage Renal Disease on Hemodialysis
pmc-10613515.creator: Athmananda Nanjundappa, Salina Munankami, Khalid Al Talib, Jyotsna Gummadi, Sumanth Kumar Bandaru
pmc-10613515.description: Ceftriaxone-induced encephalopathy is a rare but known adverse effect secondary to neurotoxicity, especially in patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) on hemodialysis. The common presenting symptoms include myoclonus, psychosis, and seizures. We are presenting a case of a 77-year-old female patient who presented with confusion and jerky movements of her lips and extremities.

pmc-11359083.title: Genome-Wide Identification of B-Box Family Genes and Their Potential Roles in Seed Development under Shading Conditions in Rapeseed
pmc-11359083.creator: Si Chen, Yushan Qiu, Yannong Lin, Songling Zou, Hailing Wang, Huiyan Zhao, Shulin Shen, Qinghui Wang, Qiqi Wang, Hai Du, Jiana Li, Cunmin Qu, Shuji Yokoi
pmc-11359083.description: B-box (BBX) proteins, a subfamily of zinc-finger transcription factors, are involved in various environmental signaling pathways. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of BBX family members in Brassica crops. The 482 BBX proteins were divided into five groups based on gene structure, conserved domains, and phylogenetic analysis.

pmc-11728223.title: Giant Primary Cutaneous Nodular Melanoma of the Forehead: A Case Report
pmc-11728223.creator: Samantha Montandon, Charles Jefferson-Loveday, Matthew Sommerlad, Harnish P Patel, Ralf Lobmann, Filipe Coutinho
pmc-11728223.description: Background: The incidence of melanoma is increasing globally. The estimated worldwide incidence is projected to increase from 324,635 cases in 2020 to 510,000 in 2040. In the UK, melanoma accounts for 4% of all new cases of cancer. Melanomas occurring in the skin of the head and neck represent 13% and 23% of cases in women and men, respectively.

pmc-11930772.title: The expression of the formin Fhod3 in mouse tongue striated muscle
pmc-11930772.creator: Hikaru Nakagawa, Yohko Kage, Ayako Miura, Hikmawan Wahyu Sulistomo, Sho Matsuyama, Yoshihiro Yamashita, Ryu Takeya
pmc-11930772.description: The sarcomere is the contractile unit of striated muscle and is composed of actin and myosin filaments. There is increasing evidence to support that actin assembly mediated by Fhod3, a member of the formin family of proteins, is critical for sarcomere formation and maintenance in cardiac muscle.

pmc-12420764.title: Biosynthetic potential of the culturable foliar fungi associated with field-grown lettuce
pmc-12420764.creator: Neda Arad, Joseph Spraker, Kayla Garcia, Duke Pauli, A Elizabeth Arnold
pmc-12420764.description: AbstractFungal endophytes and epiphytes associated with plant leaves can play important ecological roles through the production of specialized metabolites encoded by biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs). However, their functional capacity, especially in crops like lettuce (Lactuca sativa L.), remains poorly understood. We sequenced the genomes of nine fungal isolates, representing Fusarium sp., Fulvia sp.

pmc-13211554.title: Human and Hunting Dog Interactions in the United States: Exploring Potential Transmission Pathways of Zoonotic Diseases and Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Virus
pmc-13211554.creator: Rachel S. Ziejka, Justin D. Brown, Sally Thompson-Iritani, Vickie Ramirez, Hannah T. Fenelon, Marissa G. Baker
pmc-13211554.description: Simple SummarySince 2022, detections of H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) in a diversity of wild and domestic mammals in North America have elevated concerns about the impacts of this pathogen on both animal and human health. Hunting dogs that retrieve wild birds are at elevated risk for exposure to a variety of zoonotic diseases.

pmc-13563693.title: Speckle-tracking carotid strain ultrasonography for assessment of vascular dysfunction in metabolic syndrome: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13563693.creator: Elif Duygu Topan, Aral Varol, Hilal Bektaş Uysal, İmran Kurt Ömürlü, Mustafa Gök
pmc-13563693.description: BackgroundMetabolic syndrome (MetS) is associated with increased cardiovascular risk, which rises with the number of MetS components.
